dirty-stones-pile.title: Dirty Stones Pile
dirty-stones-pile.description: An interactive 3D scan of a pile of dirty stones, showing real-world textures and geometric complexities. Ideal for geology or 3D scanning education.

facts: Photogrammetry was used to capture these realistic textures.
Notice the variation in color and size of the individual stones.
In AR mode, try placing the stones on your desk.

labels.name: Texture Detail
labels.description: Observe the muddy residue baked onto the top layer.
